retrievalProfile.description: A 1980s-inspired portrait layout featuring a high-contrast serif header and a secondary handwritten script over a soft-focus coastal background.
triggerTerms: retro serif header with script overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close portrait of a subject in light-colored attire, positioned against a blurred ocean backdrop, framed by a dominant serif title at the top and a diagonal handwritten subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Large serif typography anchoring the top edge
Subject positioned slightly off-center to the right
Diagonal script text providing a dynamic counter-balance to the rigid header
Muted, warm skin tones contrasting with cool, desaturated blue water

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to a medium-close shot from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark serif letters at the top of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold header, move down the diagonal script, and settle on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant is used for the secondary script text against the blurred waves.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown and black (hair and typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value in the foreground and medium value in the background.

letterConstructionRules: Double horizontal rule underlining the main text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'J' characters feature elongated, curved descenders that drop below the baseline.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Formal high-contrast serif paired with informal, organic monoline script.
graphicDevices: Double horizontal rule under the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the flared terminal and high-contrast elegance.
Matches the casual, handwritten feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, analog-film style portrait of a person in a light cream blazer and tan shirt standing on a beach with muted blue waves in the background. Leave significant empty space at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, dark brown serif title in all-caps across the top with a double underline. Add a smaller, dark grey handwritten script title at a 15-degree upward angle in the upper left quadrant.

verificationChecks: Is the script text angled upwards?
Is the background ocean blurred to create depth?
Are the colors muted and reminiscent of 1980s film?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate existing record label logos
Ensure the text content is original
postGenerationChecks: Check for correct serif flare on display text
Verify the script text does not obscure the subject's face
Ensure the double underline is perfectly horizontal
Confirm the film grain is consistent across the image
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Soft Beach Background + [Serif Header w/ Double Underline] + [Diagonal Script Overlay]
